Timeframe.description:
Supported candle timeframes.

Values are the canonical string codes (``"1m"`` … ``"1M"``). Ordering is
by duration: ``M1 < M5 < H1 < D1 < W1 < MN1``.
Timeframe.title: Timeframe

TrendDirection.description: Directional state of price, a candle, or a structure leg.
TrendDirection.title: TrendDirection

TrendStrength.description: Qualitative trend strength from leg statistics and follow-through.
TrendStrength.title: TrendStrength

json_schema.description:
Aggregated multi-timeframe bias.

Strength rule (deterministic):
    - STRONG: every context with a known trend agrees with the bias
      (and at least two contexts exist);
    - MODERATE: weighted agreement share >= ``mtf_moderate_share``;
    - WEAK: otherwise.

``htf_influence`` is the weighted share of higher-timeframe contexts
whose direction opposes the base-timeframe trend (0 when they all agree).

agreement_share.description: Weighted share of contexts aligned with the bias.
agreement_share.title: Agreement Share

conflict_notes.description: Deterministic notes for adjacent timeframe pairs that disagree.
conflict_notes.title: Conflict Notes

htf_influence.description: Weighted share of HTF contexts opposing the base-TF trend.
htf_influence.title: Htf Influence

recommended_execution_timeframe.description: Lowest timeframe aligned with the bias; None when the base timeframe conflicts with it.

strength.description: STRONG / MODERATE / WEAK per the rule above.

json_schema.title: MTFBias
